title: 54 ## Opium Act The incidence of this crime in 1972 indicated a marginal increase of 2.6% over 1971. The state of Punjab recorded 7,094 offences under this Act approximately 62% of the total offences under this Act registered in the entire country followed by Haryana (1930) and the volume of offences under this category per one lakh of population in these two states was 51.1 and 18.7 respectively as against the All India average of 2.0. In all other states and UTs the incidence of offences under this Act is very low. Among the cities 273 offences were registered in Delhi out of 364 offences in all the cities under study together.
